name: Norish
description: Norish is a realtime, self-hosted recipe app for families and friends. Recipes are imported from a link, pasted text or photos, organised in cookbooks, planned on a calendar and turned into a shared grocery list that updates live for everyone in the household.

notes.text: There is no default account: the first sign-up becomes the admin, and sign-up closes after it. Create it right after the install.
Sign-in only works at AUTH_URL in /opt/norish_data/.env, set to the container IP. Change it for a new IP, a domain or a reverse proxy, then run systemctl restart norish.
Back up MASTER_KEY from /opt/norish_data/.env together with the database. A database restored without it locks every user out.
